question: I have been summoned for jury duty next week but I need to clarify something urgently. Could you please provide me the Superior Court contact number?

answers: There are many Superior Courts you could be referring to, such as: 1) Superior Court of California, County of Alameda, 2) Superior Court of California - County of Ventura, 3) Superior Court of California, County of Tulare, 4) Superior Court of California - County of Sacramento, 5) Superior Court of California, County of Riverside, 6) Superior Court of California, County of Tuolumne. Which one are you talking about?

Q:  What happens if I can't report on the day my group number is called because I have a doctor appointment.
A:  You may come in on another day that week. If you need to postpone, you may complete this procedure by calling 
 (805) 289-8661 or click the âRESPOND ONLINEâ button on the Jury Service page.

Q:  I've received two jury summonses for the same week but with different badge numbers. What do I do? Why did this happen?
A:  The Jury Service list is comprised of names obtained from the Department of Motor Vehicles and a list of registered 
 voters provided by the Elections Office. If your name varies in spelling between the two agencies, the jury management software treats you as two different people. 
 Please contact Jury Services for assistance. You may call (805) 289-8661or e-mail your question to jury-service@ventura.courts.ca.gov. 
 Please include both badge numbers if possible.

For more information please visit our Jury Service page.

Juvenile

Juvenile cases are confidential, except for traffic infractions. Information cannnot be given over the phone or via e-mail. In order to obtain 
 confidential information you must be a party to the case and show photo identification at the clerkâs counter when making your request.
Q:  Where will my juvenile case be heard?
A:  All juvenile matters are heard at the Juvenile and Probate Courthouse located at 4353 E. Vineyard Avenue in Oxnard.

Q:  I am a minor and received a citation and I have not received anything in the mail. Where can I get more information?
A:  If a minor received a traffic infraction ticket, you may contact the clerkâs office at (805) 289-8820 or visit the traffic page of this website. 
 Information cannot be given over the telephone for any other types of juvenile cases.

Jury Service

 Brenda L. McCormick
 

General Information on the Day of Appearance

Hours:  You must be available to report at 8:00 a.m.
 or 1:00 p.m. and able to stay until 5:00 p.m. on the day you report for jury duty.
 Due to the nature of jury service and the court process itself, there are often periods
 of waiting. We suggest you bring a book or other material to occupy your time. Our jury
 assembly rooms are equipped with TV and Wi-Fi.
